description: This file is a React component for the GameBoard in a Tic-Tac-Toe game, including game display, move handling, and game initiation logic.

methods.name: statusLabel
methods.description: Generates a label string for the game status based on the current state.

methods.name: GameBoard
methods.description: Main React component managing the game board UI and interactions.

methods.name: GameInitiator
methods.description: Subcomponent for creating or joining a game.

methods.name: handleMove
methods.description: Handles a player's move when a cell is clicked.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Creates a new game via API call.

methods.name: handleJoin
methods.description: Joins an existing game by ID via API call.
